close_reason: Migrated 29 wire-format structs across 6 client crates (mail-client +9, chat-client +10, calendars-client +2, contacts-client +1, filenode-client +2, base-client +5). Sharing-client and tasks-client had no in-scope structs (only internal SessionClient). Canonical pattern: #[serde(flatten, default, skip_serializing_if = serde_json::Map::is_empty)] pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>. For Serialize-only method-arg structs, test pattern is *_propagates_vendor_extras (construct + serialize). For Deserialize method-response structs, test pattern is *_preserves_vendor_extras (deserialize + capture). CalendarEventGetParams excluded as a non-serde Rust-side builder helper. Gates clean: cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --all -- --check.
description:
Apply the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy) to the typed method-argument and method-response structs defined in *-client crates.

In scope (estimate ~10-15 public wire-shaped Deserialize structs):
- jmap-mail-client::EmailSubmissionSetParams (already migrated for PatchObject in JMAP-6h5s.1)
- jmap-mail-client::MailboxSetParams
- jmap-mail-client::EmailGetParams
- jmap-mail-client::EmailCopyParams
- jmap-calendars-client::CalendarEventGetParams
- jmap-contacts-client::AddressBookSetParams
- jmap-filenode-client::FileNodeSetParams
- Other client-defined typed request bodies (audit each *-client/src/methods/ for #[derive(Deserialize)] structs).

Out of scope:
- Response wrappers (GetResponse<T> etc. live in jmap-types and are covered by the jmap-types child).
- Internal client state types (ClientState, AuthProvider, etc.).

Acceptance: every in-scope struct has `pub extra: Map<String, Value>` with the documented attributes; one round-trip preservation test per type; cargo test/clippy/fmt clean.
notes: jmap-chat-client extras-preservation pass complete: 10 structs migrated (ChatCapability, ChatPushCapability, Quota, BlobLookupEntry, BlobLookupResponse, BlobObject, BlobConvertResponse, PushSubscriptionCreateResponse, TypingResponse, SpaceJoinResponse). 10 new *_preserves_vendor_extras tests across 4 files; quota.rs gained a new tests module. All structs are Deserialize-only — no struct-literal construction sites needed extra={} updates. cargo check / test / clippy --tests -D warnings / fmt all clean. Inline tests in src/: 35 -> 45.
title: Adopt extras policy in *-client crates (method param structs)
